legend: Generator for a test case of this problem.
A certain Icelandic singer absolutely hates repeating himself. It seems tedious and not very interesting to him.

This means each word he says is not equal to a string concatenated $$$2$$$ or more times. Formally, he can say a word $$$w$$$, if $$$w$$$ cannot be written as $$$s + s + \cdots + s$$$ ($$$k$$$ times, with $$$k \gt 1$$$). So he cannot say "hahaha" (can be written as "ha" + "ha" + "ha"), but he can say "endurtakamig". (The phrase "Endurtaka mig" is Icelandic for "Repeat myself".) You are analyzing a sentence spoken by the singer. You only forgot to add spaces between the words, so you are looking for an optimal way to do so. What is the minimum number of words to split the string into, such that each word could have been spoken by this singer?
input: One line with a string $$$s$$$ ($$$1\leq |s|\leq {3\cdot10^5}$$$), the sentence spoken.
The sentence only consists of English lowercase letters (a-z), it does not contain spaces.
output: Output the minimum number of words $$$k$$$ in the sentence, followed by $$$k$$$ strings which form a possible subdivision of the sentence into words.
If there are multiple valid solutions, you may output any one of them.

legend.ai: 某位冰岛歌手极其讨厌重复自己。这在他看来既乏味又没什么意思。

这意味着，他说出的每个单词都不能等于将某个字符串连接 $$$2$$$ 次或更多次得到的结果。严格地说，如果 $$$w$$$ 不能写成 $$$s + s + \cdots + s$$$(重复 $$$k$$$ 次，且满足 $$$k \gt 1$$$)，那么他可以说出单词 $$$w$$$。因此，他不能说“hahaha”(可以写成“ha”+“ha”+“ha”)，但可以说“endurtakamig”。(短语“Endurtaka mig”在冰岛语中意为“重复我自己”。)

你正在分析这位歌手说的一句话。你只是忘记在单词之间添加空格，因此需要寻找一种最优的添加空格方式。将该字符串分割成若干个单词，使得每个单词都可能是这位歌手说出的，最少需要分成多少个单词？

input.ai: 一行包含字符串 $$$s$$$($$$1\leq |s|\leq {3\cdot10^5}$$$)，即所说的句子。
该句仅由英文字母小写字母（a-z）组成，不包含空格。

output.ai: 输出句子中的最少单词数 $$$k$$$，随后输出 $$$k$$$ 个字符串，表示将该句子划分为单词的一种可能方案。
如果存在多个有效解，你可以输出其中任意一个。
